description: Agent Commitments: submit the messages and work records an agent wrote with the commitment records captured from them: each source with its id, its kind (a message, an email, a chat, a meeting note, a ticket or a work record), who wrote it and to whom, when, its text as written, read for promise wording such as I will send or we promise and for promises made without saying so such as leave it with me or I am on it, and optionally how many promises it makes as recorded; and each commitment record with its id, the id of the source it was made in, the promiser, the promisee, the deliverable, the deadline as a date and the event it is due on. The signed report gives every source with the promise wording read from it, the promises it makes, the records that capture them and its status as captured, partly_captured, uncaptured, implied_uncaptured, no_promise or unconfirmed, every record with its status as complete, party_missing, deliverable_missing, deadline_missing or unsourced, and counts the promises, records and uncaptured promises, and names promises left uncaptured: promises said outright with no commitment record, promises made without saying so with no record, records with no promiser or promisee, and records with nothing promised; then records with no deadline or event and records with no source, with the fix for each. This reads the promises an agent itself makes: who delegated what to whom is wever_delegation-record-check, and who owns which task in a multi-agent plan is wever_coordination-plan-check. Verdict commitments_uncaptured, commitment_capture_gaps, commitment_capture_unverified or commitments_captured. POST /api/commitment-capture-check. Reads only the recorded promises and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no promise is made, changed or closed and no promisee is contacted. Agent Commitments reads the promises an agent makes itself, from capture to closure: it is not delegation (assigning work and authority to another agent, the wever_delegation checks; a commitment is the agent’s own promise, whoever ends up doing the work), not coordination (how agents organize shared work, the wever_coordination checks), not reputation (the durable standing a track record earns, the wever_reputation checks; commitments are the individual promises that record is built from), not the loop on feedback received (wever_feedback-closure-check; this family closes the agent’s own promises) and not who answers for an outcome (wever_ownership-map-brief; this family tracks the promise itself). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-commitments-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-commitments/.

sources.description: Each message or work record that may hold a promise.

id.description: The source id, such as s1.

text.description: The source as written, read for promise wording such as I will or leave it with me.
